item.title: Bitcoin, Ripple Led Crypto Donations In 2025
item.description: The average gift of cryptocurrency during 2025 was $11,019 across The Giving Block Platform, with 21% of the gifts were valued at $100,000. The average gift was more — $1,704 — if it came via a donor-advised fund.
